Definition: from G1859; to observe a festival:--keep the feast.
BiblicalUsage: In Scripture, heortázō means keep the feast. It occurs just once, in 1 Corinthians.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is simple here: heortázō means keep the feast, and I do not stretch it further.
